dev-rear-lamp.product: Rear lamp (combined rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and retro-reflector in a single housing)

parts.name: Rear position lamp
parts.function: Rear position signalling indicating vehicle presence and width from the rear; red light, on-axis intensity 4 to 17 cd

parts.name: Stop lamp
parts.function: Braking indication to following road users; red light, on-axis intensity 60 to 185 cd
safety_relevance: intensity ratio to rear position lamp in combined/reciprocally incorporated function

parts.name: Reversing lamp
parts.function: Illuminates road to the rear and warns other road users when reversing; white light, visible to 45° outboard

parts.name: Retro-reflector
parts.function: Passive conspicuity by returning incident light toward source; molded PMMA prism optics, reflectivity checked at 5° angle of incidence

parts.name: Outer lens
parts.function: Light transmission and colour definition; red-tinted UV-stabilised PMMA within chromaticity limits
safety_relevance: UV and weathering resistance of plastic lens materials

parts.name: Reflector
parts.function: Optical reflector (PC with aluminium vacuum-metallised coating) shaping light distribution for the rear position lamp

parts.name: LED modules on PCB
parts.function: Light source for lamp functions; electronic sub-assembly on printed circuit board

parts.name: Housing
parts.function: Structural enclosure (PP or ASA/PC) carrying optics, electronics and mounting points

parts.name: Seal / gasket
parts.function: Sealing between lens and housing (TPE or silicone); no water ingress after spray test

parts.name: Fasteners / clips
parts.function: Attach lamp to vehicle body (PA, POM or steel); keep lamp aimed under vibration

parts.name: Approval marking
parts.function: Identification of approved device and functions on lens/housing

holdout-acpe.product: Acceleration Control for Pedal Error (ACPE) system

parts.name: Front ultrasonic sensors
parts.function: Detect obstacles ahead of the vehicle at parking and manoeuvring speeds

parts.name: Rear ultrasonic sensors
parts.function: Detect obstacles behind the vehicle at parking and manoeuvring speeds (reverse)
safety_relevance: obstacle detection for ACPE intervention in reverse

parts.name: Ultrasonic sensor housing
parts.function: Encloses and protects ultrasonic transducer; PBT-GF30

parts.name: Front camera
parts.function: Detects obstacles ahead of the vehicle to support pedal-error intervention
safety_relevance: field of view / driver vision interference

parts.name: Camera housing and lens
parts.function: Aluminium die-cast housing with PC lens protecting camera

parts.name: Powertrain control unit with ACPE software function
parts.function: Fuses obstacle and pedal input data, detects pedal error and limits or suppresses propulsion torque

parts.name: Control unit hardware (PCB with microcontroller, aluminium housing)
parts.function: Hosts ACPE software and processing electronics

parts.name: Accelerator pedal position sensor
parts.function: Detects sudden, strong accelerator pedal input indicative of pedal error

parts.name: Instrument cluster tell-tale
parts.function: Visual warning on intervention, deactivation status and system fault

parts.name: Buzzer
parts.function: Acoustic warning when the system intervenes

parts.name: Deactivation switch in infotainment menu
parts.function: Allows driver deactivation; system reactivates at next engine start

parts.name: Wiring harness
parts.function: Power and signal connection between sensors, control unit and HMI; copper with PVC/XLPE insulation

parts.name: Fault reporting function
parts.function: Detects and reports system faults to the driver
